The Nothing Phone (4b) is here! In this video, we unbox Nothing's newest smartphone and take a detailed first look at its design, Glyph Bar, display, performance, cameras, Nothing OS, battery, and more. Has Nothing managed to deliver the complete experience without cutting corners? Let's find out!
